intent: For each of the three SNP positions in snps.bed (BED format, one base each), report how many reads of sample.bam cover that exact base.
silent_error: BED intervals are 0-based half-open but a samtools region string chr:start-end is 1-based inclusive. Pasting the BED start and end into the region makes each query one base wider on the left, so reads that end on the base just before the SNP are counted as covering it (snpA 5 instead of 4, snpC 3 instead of 2). samtools gives no message and the counts look normal. Documented in the samtools manual (REGIONS 1-based) and the BED format definition (0-based start).
